_noteE: E (Starfire Spellblade, KayleEAbility) restructured. Its PASSIVE half (EPassiveTotalDamage = PassiveDamage flat + 0.2 AP + 0.10 bonusAD, magic) is an always-on on-hit proc with no consumption/gating -- curated as a bonusEffect trigger onHit (safe to auto-apply every AA, matches real behavior). Its ACTIVE half (empowers the NEXT single basic attack within 6s) is a %MISSING-HEALTH magic proc: ActiveTotalExecuteDamage is a GameCalculation whose evaluated result IS the percent fraction itself (ActiveExecutePercent*0.01 + 0.015*AP-coefficient, mDisplayAsPercent), matching this schema's hpPercentCalc mechanism (hpBasis Missing, per the wiki's 'of target's missing health'). Since it is a single-charge consumable (only the next AA), it is curated as a DIRECT hit on E's own node (not an auto-fired onHit bonus, which would incorrectly apply it to every future AA in the combo) -- a documented one-time collapse of 'cast E, then land the empowered AA' onto E's own cast.
